report.notes: Reviewer claude now runs with a fresh driver-made CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR (credentials file plus allowlisted ~/.claude.json account keys only, deleted after the run) and --setting-sources "". Real claude 2.1.296 honors the env in ~/.claude.json even with --setting-sources "", so the separate config dir is required. is_independent requires config_isolated=True for real milestones. A codex reviewer gets a fresh CODEX_HOME with only auth.json (untested: codex not installed). Managed policy dirs (/etc/claude-code, macOS/Windows equivalents, /etc/codex) are bound as control_state.reviewer_policy, and a change is TAMPER; a run planned earlier records only this new key at its next step (that path has no test). New tests: test_r7_01_worker_written_user_claude_settings_cannot_verify_a_real_milestone[3 params], test_r7_01_reviewer_gets_a_driver_made_config_dir_with_credentials_only, test_r7_01_managed_policy_written_by_a_worker_is_tamper; all fail on aba8ac05 (the base commit reaches VERIFIED in all 3 variants) and pass now. The test_r6_02 assertion was changed from 'user' to '' (stricter). Full tests/dev_workflow: 185 passed. Real-CLI check: the repaired run_worker sent 0 requests to the scripted endpoint; the base-commit argv in the same HOME sent 5. Not verified: a successful signed-in real review with the fresh dir (no stored credentials here); a macOS-keychain-only login may fail to sign in, which fails closed to waiting for the model. Remaining risk: a lingering same-user process could write and then remove env in the fresh .claude.json during the run. graphify update was not run (graphify-out/ is outside the permitted paths).
